vision: Centralize and standardize ML feature management through a unified feature store that eliminates duplication, ensures consistency between training and inference, and accelerates model development while reducing computational costs.
scope: Develop an MVP ML feature store integrated with Feast, Databricks, and Redis to enable batch and real-time feature computation, feature versioning, lineage tracking, monitoring, and secure access control. Out of scope: feature discovery UI, automated schema evolution beyond MVP.
success_criteria: Feature serving latency under 10ms (p99) for 50 features
Cost reduction of feature computation below $25K/month
Model training-serving consistency with <2% feature skew difference
Data scientist productivity increased by 30% (time spent on model dev)
Support 500 concurrent requests through feature API

user_stories.title: Implement central feature registry with versioning and metadata management
user_stories.i_want: to register and version features with descriptive metadata and lineage tracking
user_stories.so_that: I can reuse features safely and ensure reproducibility across models

acceptance_criteria.when: I register it through the Python SDK
acceptance_criteria.then: the feature appears in the registry with version, owner, and lineage metadata

user_stories.title: Enable batch feature computation and storage in offline Databricks Feature Store
user_stories.i_want: to compute features in hourly or daily batches using Spark jobs
user_stories.so_that: the features can be used for model training with point-in-time correctness

acceptance_criteria.given: source tables in the data lake
acceptance_criteria.then: computed features are written to the offline store with consistent timestamps

user_stories.title: Provide real-time feature serving with <10ms latency using Redis
user_stories.i_want: to fetch feature vectors instantly from the online store
user_stories.so_that: I can serve model predictions at low latency in production

acceptance_criteria.given: a deployed Redis cache with 50 features per request

user_stories.title: Implement point-in-time correct joins to prevent training-serving skew
user_stories.i_want: to automatically retrieve historical feature values that match training timestamps
user_stories.so_that: I can ensure training data accuracy and consistency with inference

acceptance_criteria.given: a training dataset with event timestamps
acceptance_criteria.when: I request features through Feast’s API
acceptance_criteria.then: the system performs point-in-time correct joins and returns aligned feature values

user_stories.title: Enable feature monitoring and drift detection to ensure model stability
user_stories.i_want: to automatically detect data drift and feature distribution shifts
user_stories.so_that: I can monitor model health and take corrective actions before performance degradation

acceptance_criteria.then: alerts are generated with affected feature metadata and severity level

user_stories.title: Implement team-based access control via Unity Catalog integration
user_stories.i_want: to manage permissions for feature creation and access per team
user_stories.so_that: I can enforce data governance and prevent unauthorized usage

acceptance_criteria.given: Unity Catalog configuration for user roles
acceptance_criteria.when: a user attempts to read or modify a feature
acceptance_criteria.then: access is granted or denied based on their team permissions

user_stories.title: Expose Python SDK and REST API for feature access and management
user_stories.i_want: to retrieve features and register new ones programmatically
user_stories.so_that: I can integrate feature store operations into my modeling workflows

acceptance_criteria.when: I call SDK or REST endpoints
acceptance_criteria.then: features are returned or updated correctly with validation and error handling
